lines: Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Chain 18 is read whole and on origin main (`8685e6cf`, pushed 06:19 UTC): summer's sand third push and summer's base sixth list. On it: tsc exit 0, the base made again, build exit 0, engine `60d39792f3f3d6c1`; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8379" (threshold 0.75; base 0.838, miniature 0.953); M4 0.9694, 0.9106, 0.9546, 0.9607 and M5 0.9929, 1, 0.9686, 0.9997, all pass; 2 of the eight draft stills changed, summer's two, as they should; the whole vitest 67 files passed and 1 skipped, 925 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass; triangles at high: summer 1,755,707 of 1,800,000, the others unchanged. The detail number for summer is lower than before the two merges (0.8522 on chain 16): the base's share fell by 0.014, still over the threshold.

Picture 1 is summer at rest as on main now, the approved picture left and the build right. Picture 2 is summer's base: the approved picture above, main before in the middle, main now below. My look: no worse anywhere and somewhat better in three places. The shells read matte cream and no longer glazed white, the lip's strokes sit lower and no longer read as a painted stripe, the sand's mound at the right foot is broader with a soft shade. Both merges stay. It is below the bar and is not a pass: the base is greyer and flatter than the approved, its fold low left is shading with no real height, a saw edge stands at the seat's left end, the glass pieces are flat, and the heap is smaller and paler than the approved's. The base's seventh list is ordered: real height for the fold and the swells, the saw edge, the shells' rib crests, an inner glow in the glass pieces. Push by 07:35 UTC.

Picture 3 is the shutter for the 4K masters: film frames 712 to 715 at 3840, spring's roots at two times. Its builder drew that chunk twice on cold starts and got the same bytes (STATED by the builder, one sha256 for both). My look at three cuts of it, the roots, the cottage's windows through the petals and the glass's outline, finds no comb, no doubled edge and no step: moving things soften evenly. With that both conditions of decision 182 are met and the shutter's new deal is merged here as chain 19, alone, running since 06:21 UTC and not on origin yet. Two more frames the new way and the old way, 1398 and 2064, are still to come from its builder and can still send the merge back. With it on main the masters can be drawn the new way. It is not yet a pass for 4K motion: spring's lit moss still changes between frames at 3840.

Picture 4 is fall's scene, its fifth list: the approved picture left, main before in the middle, the fifth list right, the ground and fence above, the cottage below. Gained: the ground has lost its orange, the wall and the chimney are darker, the trunk's body is dark and its lit flank warm, the purple pane sits on the approved's tones. Not gained: the ground is now darker than the approved, the fence reads as a pale thicket, the trunk's far edge shows a pale strip at the foot, the stones are still paler and blockier than the approved's. It goes into fall's chain as it is, with the air's fourth list (the green band under the base's lip is taken down, the sparks' cores are smaller), right after chain 19. A sixth list for the scene is ordered, tone only: fall has no triangles left.

Held, not on main: fall's base with a grain on the vines (`agent/p6-fall-base` `b2a13724`). Its detail number rose to 0.9017 on its builder's machine, but the grain reads as frost over most of each vine where the approved has dark wet wood with a few glints. Its builder said so before I looked and I rule the same. One more try with a third of the grain and only inside the lit ridge, push by 06:55 UTC; if that does not read right it falls back to the list before the grain.

Round 22 on summer started 06:21 UTC on `8685e6cf`: the machine checks, the measures with the pack, and the motion sheets are being drawn on three helper machines; the critics and jurors follow when the pack is in. It is summer's third round and the last inside decision 132's limit. By my own look summer is below the bar, so I do not expect a pass; the round is run for the critics' lists, and a round after it is logged as past the limit.

The change of season: nothing pushed. Its finisher found a new fault of its own in shake 3 (the glass's mean falls 7.2 and 11.3 levels at film frames 2116 and 2117, against the bar of 6, STATED) and mends it first; push about 08:25 UTC. Summer's air bends its take over across frames 1401 to 1421, push 06:45. Preview 06 is drawn when the change's push is on main.

The controls: its finisher's twelve points are answered. Still wrong by its own walk: an early press links programs in the middle of a shake, the hint and a press come late when the page's thread stands, a half pixel shift at 600 x 600. Not seen by it: anything at 60 a second, sound, touch, Safari, Firefox on a real card, a screen reader.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 18's review still of summer, its change measure and eight draft stills; chain 19's are running. On helper machines: the builders' own stills and the shutter's chunk of four 3840 frames, twice. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
phase 6: 27.61 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 27.61 h used of 12.00 h allowed
